dialogue.speaker: Ember
dialogue.text: You came back for me... and we made it past their boss!

dialogue.speaker: Milo
dialogue.text: That roof gun finally has a proper gunner.

dialogue.speaker: Ember
dialogue.text: Then let me stay. I want to keep fighting with you!

dialogue.speaker: Mochi
dialogue.text: Your crew got me out of that cage. I owe you one.

dialogue.speaker: Ember
dialogue.text: You kept that mortar firing all the way to their boss.

dialogue.speaker: Mochi
dialogue.text: There's an empty seat with my name on it. Can I come along?
